objective: Distinguish the dominant Build 001 throughput causes with factor-isolated intervention evidence before changing production policy semantics.

source_freeze.resolution_rule: Run every declared experiment only from the clean commit containing this declaration; bind that exact commit, tree, first-party source hash, worktree state, and intervention flags into each artifact.
source_freeze.semantic_boundary: Allocator tracing and automatic-checkpoint switches exist only on the diagnostic evaluation surface, default on, require FULL plus hot-path profiling when disabled, and are forbidden on public-holdout. Checkpoint suppression is an intervention, not a production repair.

synthetic_factorial.order: rotated Gray-code orders; every repetition contains all four cells, complete four-repetition blocks balance position, and later blocks reverse direction

embedded_action_selection_microbenchmark.method: read-only ARC3Controller._candidate_actions on an unchanged post-transition synthetic state with an active world-model ensemble

development_factorial.command_template: C:/a/arc3-b001-28c7a00/Scripts/python.exe -m scripts.evaluate_public --partition development --agents full --seeds 7 --max-actions 8 --max-resets 8 --timeout-seconds 120.0 --frozen-commit <PREDECLARATION_COMMIT> --manifest <REPOSITORY>/docs/evaluation/public-game-partitions.v0.1.json --environments-dir C:/a/arc3-s15-6a0f6e5/artifacts/stage15/public-environments --recordings-dir C:/a/arc3-b001/recordings/stage03 --output-root C:/a/arc3-b001/artifacts/stage03/evaluations --exposure-ledger C:/a/arc3-b001/artifacts/stage03/public-exposure.jsonl --milestone-id build-001-stage03-causal-v0.1 --game-ids ar25-0c556536 --hot-path-profile <EXPLICIT_TRACING_FLAG> <EXPLICIT_CHECKPOINT_FLAG> --evaluation-id <CELL_EVALUATION_ID>

causal_decision_rules.behavior_control: A cell is interpretable only if its exact action-decision signature and environment outcome match the control at the same seed and budget; otherwise preserve it as a behavioral difference and do not attribute the timing delta to pure implementation cost.
causal_decision_rules.material_cause: Supported when the one-factor intervention saves at least 15 percent of matched total wall time or at least 0.25 seconds per environment action in local-public evidence, with the behavior control satisfied and the synthetic factorial direction not materially contradictory.
causal_decision_rules.interaction: Report both additive difference-of-differences and multiplicative cross-ratio; never sum marginal savings when interaction is material.
causal_decision_rules.action_selection_internal_candidate: Supported as a concrete implementation-cost candidate only if active-ensemble cProfile rows show repeated prediction and state-id work with exact read-only output/state identity. It remains unresolved as an end-to-end repair until a later behavior-preserving cache/reuse intervention exists.
causal_decision_rules.contradicted: Classify a proposed dominant cause as contradicted on this measured episode when direct phase accounting or intervention evidence is below the material threshold; this does not prove absence on other games or longer histories.
causal_decision_rules.unresolved: Use when the experiment does not isolate the factor, changes behavior, lacks enough calls/actions, or conflicts across synthetic and local-public surfaces.

acceptance.required_profiles: enabled in all four local-public cells
